name: Hermineo Data - Quimper proximity datacenter
developer: Quimper Bretagne Occidentale / Quimper Communauté Télécom / Axione
notes: Opened at Créac'h Gwen on the Quimper Bretagne Occidentale territory after completion in late 2025; investment reported at EUR 600k.

name: Conseil départemental du Finistère datacenter in existing building
notes: Public tender listing for a global performance contract to construct a datacenter in an existing departmental building; buyer listed as Conseil Départemental du Finistère.

name: Ifremer Centre Datarmor - Brest/Plouzané
notes: Research computing and data infrastructure at Ifremer Bretagne, Brest/Plouzané; renovated/modernized Datarmor center celebrated in September 2025.

name: ETIX Nîmes #1 / Neticenter Nîmes
notes: Nîmes Métropole business site says the datacenter is managed by Netiwan and located in the Bouillargues business park; DataCenterMap records the former Neticenter as operational and rebranded under ETIX.

name: ETIX Auch / FullSave AUC00
notes: FullSave opened the Auch facility in June 2023; reported as two 70 sqm IT rooms and 30 racks. DataCenterMap lists 1 MW and operational status, later rebranded/acquired by ETIX.

name: Equinix BX1 Bordeaux
notes: Equinix lists BX1 as Bordeaux's first carrier-neutral data center at 39 rue de Strasbourg, Bruges, with 516 sqm of colocation space and renewable energy coverage.

name: TDF Bordeaux-Bouliac Data Center
notes: TDF says its first Bordeaux-Bouliac data center opened in May 2013 and a second facility was inaugurated at the end of November 2018; page lists 1,000 kVA IT power and 1,200 kVA extension potential.

name: BXIA sovereign AI campus - Bordeaux Parc des Expositions
notes: Planned five-building sovereign AI campus on roughly 20 hectares at Bordeaux's Parc des Expositions; DCD reports 250 MW IT capacity and 380 MW available power, with possible operation by 2028.

name: Vantage / Altarea AI and cloud data center campus near Bordeaux
notes: Vantage and Altarea announced a strategic partnership for a large AI/cloud campus close to Bordeaux; Altarea had secured a 400 MW utility power connection.

name: Canal+ Télécom Guadeloupe datacenter - Jarry/Baie-Mahault
notes: Inaugurated at Moudong in the Jarry industrial area, Baie-Mahault; reported as Tier 3/HDS and positioned at Antilles-Guyane submarine cable crossroads.

name: DataCenter ONE - Les Abymes
notes: HELIUM describes DataCenter ONE aux Abymes as a next-generation Guadeloupe datacenter built in 2017 with 50 sqm of hosting space, high-speed fiber and Jarry backbone connectivity.

name: Wayscom Cloud datacenter - Cayenne
notes: Wayscom states that VPS, hosting and colocation are operated from its local Cayenne datacenter in French Guiana, with operations since 2005.

name: Guyane Numérique datacenter network
notes: Guyane Numérique network pages list 2 data centers for GNU backbone and hosting services, plus NTR/NRA network nodes across French Guiana.

name: Digicel Business Collery datacenter
notes: Digicel Business advertises secure datacenter hosting with a data center situated at Collery, with symmetric internet access, fixed IP and secured power/connectivity options.

name: Microsoft Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération datacenter campus
notes: Microsoft's official France investment announcement says it will plan a new datacenter campus in the Grand Est region in Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération; Petit-Landau municipal notice references the Microsoft 1985 France Sàrl public inquiry.

name: SITEC Bastia datacenter
notes: SITEC says it owns the only two datacenters in Corsica; its hosting service page describes two ISO 27001 and HDS-certified datacenters, including Bastia/Furiani infrastructure.

name: Prosoluce SG-1 - Saint-Gaudens
notes: DCD reported Prosoluce broke ground in January 2023 at Comminge Futuropole, Saint-Gaudens, with service expected summer 2023; project cost about EUR 3m and was Prosoluce's first fully-owned data center.

name: ETIX Toulouse data center
notes: ETIX describes its Toulouse facility as a carrier-neutral colocation and connectivity hub serving aerospace, healthcare, public-sector and industrial users in Occitanie.

name: FullSave / Eurofiber Labège Toulouse datacenter
notes: Eurofiber said FullSave owned and operated a 1,600 sqm datacenter in Toulouse; a 2026 Eurofiber/ETIX release lists Toulouse and a Labège colocation unit among the Occitanie datacenter assets planned for ETIX acquisition.

name: Alti-Data / Le Puy-en-Velay data center
developer: Département de la Haute-Loire / Communauté d'agglomération du Puy-en-Velay
notes: Archived public works tender for creation of a data center at ZI de Taulhac, Le Puy-en-Velay; DCmag reported the mutualized project name Alti-Data and an investment budget of about EUR 1.5415m.
